sermon.title: Gospel Commitment Brings Gospel Rewards 01/28/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that success comes from committing to follow Jesus, not faith alone. From Mark 8 and 10, believers deny themselves daily, refuse to deny Christ and are redeemed only by his precious blood. Those who leave houses and family for the gospel receive eternal life and a hundredfold now, with persecutions—even from their own household.
